answer: Epoch fingerprint carryover check requires each identity to match its prior-epoch interaction trace within a small delta or start fresh with no inherited access. The rule compares a stored relic of last epoch's behaviour with current activity and resets standing on mismatch. An attacker pays a per-identity cost of sustaining each sybil through repeated epochs with consistent traces, fees, and wait time—an umber overhead that makes mass creation uneconomic.
